question_text: Explain why durability is important after a venue confirms a ticket purchase.
adaptation_rationale: Durability explicit within ACID. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: Once committed, the booking must survive a system crash, so the customer retains the reserved seat and payment/booking state is not silently lost.

marking_points.criterion: Links persistence to confirmed seat/payment obligation.
